title: LSP/1 closed metadata contract (validation envelope is not wire JSON)
description: The decoder supplies direction/opcode/status/request_bound from validated header and local session state. Only metadata is serialized on the wire. Capacity-only GP replies have no LSP metadata and are checked separately.

reuse_existing_key.description: With true, payload is empty and CAS reuses the live existing Key inside TA.

base_url.description: HTTPS API prefix, normalized and bound to the credential. UTF-8 byte length at most 1024.

x-semantic-checks-outside-json-schema: strict UTF-8 / duplicate keys / no float literals / depth 8
header association and three length equality
payload format, slice coverage, credit, offsets and sequence
per-session request and terminal transition history
HTTP_HEAD encoded payload byte size and body stream intent
